## Severity: P2

## Failure
test-plugin-scripts-no-relative-paths.sh fails on PR #193 (consolidated retroactive review of bug da45 sprint code):

```
/home/runner/.../plugins/dso/scripts/write-cycle-ledger.sh:74:source "$SCRIPT_DIR/../hooks/lib/deps.sh"   # provides get_artifacts_dir
```

The relative-paths-in-plugin-scripts policy violation was introduced during the unreviewed sprint on epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (story aead-ae88-6e97-476b — write-cycle-ledger.sh implementation).

## Expected fix
Replace `$SCRIPT_DIR/../hooks/lib/deps.sh` with a plugin-root-resolved path:

```bash
_PLUGIN_ROOT="${_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso}"
source "$_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/lib/deps.sh"
```

per plugin path conventions.

## Origin
Sprint commits introduced this without review (bug da45). To be fixed when the per-story PR for aead-ae88 lands.

## Related
- Parent bug da45-7d92-6c86-42bc (P0): retroactive review remediation
- File: plugins/dso/scripts/write-cycle-ledger.sh:74
